new_measures.axl:border-radius: Computed border-radius of the element in px (the largest of its four corner radii); 9999px-style pills are read as their computed value.
new_measures.axl:nested-cards: Count of ui:card elements that have another ui:card as an ancestor, across the page.
new_measures.axl:distinct-border-radii: Number of distinct computed border-radius values (px) across all elements with a non-zero radius on the page.
new_measures.axl:distinct-icon-grids: Number of distinct viewBox sizes across ui:icon SVG elements on the page.
new_measures.axl:distinct-stroke-widths: Number of distinct computed stroke-width values (px) across ui:icon elements on the page.
new_measures.axl:concentric-radius-error: For every rounded element nested in a rounded parent, the absolute difference in px between the parent radius and (child radius + padding between them), ignoring pairs whose padding is over 24px; the maximum over the page.
new_measures.axl:nested-radius-larger-than-parent: Count of rounded elements whose border-radius is larger than their rounded parent's border-radius.
new_measures.axl:distinct-shadow-levels: Number of distinct computed box-shadow values (other than none) used for elevation across the page.
new_measures.axl:box-shadow-layers: Largest number of comma-separated layers in the computed box-shadow of any matching element.
new_measures.axl:identical-shadow-count: Largest number of elements on the page sharing the same computed box-shadow or drop-shadow value.
new_measures.axl:hard-offset-shadows: Count of elements with a box-shadow layer that has a non-zero offset and zero blur.
new_measures.axl:shadow-max-alpha: Largest alpha (0-1) of any colour in any computed box-shadow layer on the page.
new_measures.axl:backdrop-blur-containers: Count of elements with a blurring backdrop-filter and a translucent background.
new_measures.axl:backdrop-blur-on-scrolling: Count of elements with a backdrop-filter that are neither position:fixed nor position:sticky.
new_measures.axl:emoji-count: Number of emoji characters in the rendered text, markup and alt text of the matching elements.
new_measures.axl:all-pill-buttons: 1 if every button on the page has a computed border-radius of at least 999px or 50%, otherwise 0.
new_measures.axl:icons-not-currentcolor: Count of ui:icon elements whose computed fill and stroke are not currentColor (a single primary-CTA icon excepted).
new_measures.axl:border-width-state-shift: Largest difference in px between a field's default border-width and its border-width in hover, focus, error and disabled states.
new_measures.axl:varied-grid-cells: For every multi-cell grid or bento on the page, the number of cells whose background is an image, gradient, pattern or tint rather than plain surface colour; the minimum over all such grids.
new_measures.axl:icon-size-off-grid: Count of ui:icon elements whose rendered size in px is not one of 16, 20, 24 or 32.
new_measures.axl:elevation-lightness-step: In dark mode, the smallest difference in lightness (percentage points) between a surface and the surface one elevation level below it.
new_measures.axl:buried-raster-count: Count of raster background images sitting under a gradient wash of alpha above 0.9, or on an element with near-zero opacity.
new_measures.axl:raster-icons: Count of ui:icon elements that are raster images (png, jpg, webp, gif) rather than SVG.
new_measures.axl:non-inline-svg-icons: Count of ui:icon elements that are not inline <svg> (img src references, icon fonts, package components).
new_measures.axl:soft-shadows: Count of box-shadow layers with a non-zero blur radius on the matching elements.
new_measures.axl:card-count: Number of ui:card elements on the page.
new_measures.axl:rows-with-top-and-bottom-borders: Count of list items or table rows whose computed border-top-width and border-bottom-width are both above 0.
new_measures.axl:translucent-fills: Count of matching elements whose computed background-color has alpha below 1.
